name: Apple Crisp
desc: Sliced tart apples baked under a brown sugar, oat and nutmeg crumble.

source.title: Apple Crisp
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (4 tart apples, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup each flour and oats, 1/3 cup butter, 3/4 tsp each cinnamon and nutmeg) and the same 375°F, 30 minute bake.

ingredients.raw: 4 medium tart cooking apples such as Granny Smith (about 1 1/2 lb), cored and sliced 1/2 inch thick (about 4 cups)
ingredients.note: such as Granny Smith; about 1 1/2 lb, 4 cups sliced

ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup quick-cooking or old-fashioned rolled oats
Butter or shortening, for greasing the pan

steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Grease the bottom and sides of an 8-inch square (2-quart) baking dish.
Peel the apples if you like, core them, and cut into 1/2-inch slices. Spread them in an even layer in the dish.
In a medium bowl, mix the brown sugar, flour, oats, butter, cinnamon and nutmeg with a fork or pastry blender until it looks like coarse crumbs. Sprinkle evenly over the apples.
Bake about 30 minutes, until the topping is golden brown and the apples are tender when pierced with a fork.
Cool 10 minutes, then serve warm with ice cream.
